name: pr_open
description: A pull request exists. No manifest has been derived and no instrument has measured any build of it.

name: manifest_derived
description: The labeller read the diff and wrote app:* and itil:standard/normal. The manifest is derived; a human edit to it does not survive the next push.

name: manifest_asserted
description: labeler:skip is set. app:* is now hand-maintained: the manifest is a wish rather than a derivation, declared in label form.

name: class_single
description: Exactly one itil:* class. Every rule that branches on the class has an arm to take.

name: class_undefined
description: Zero or two-or-more itil:* classes. Not a nuance: every downstream rule branches on a class nobody chose. preflight exits 2 and refuses rather than picking.

name: change_requested
description: A person added change:requested. The only label a human adds to set a change going; the pipeline clears it.

name: emergency_declared
description: itil:emergency. A person claims THIS change is the remedy. Never inferred. Bypasses the freeze and the queue; bypasses neither guard 2 nor guard 5.

name: draft_held
description: The author says it is not ready. The one input no guard derives, measures or infers - the pipeline believes it.

name: suite_not_yet
description: INDETERMINATE (not yet). No check run exists for this head. The expected state for a fresh push and not a finding about anything.

name: suite_pending
description: INDETERMINATE (not finished). Latest run per name is in_progress with conclusion null. Counted as not-green, never as failed.

name: suite_void
description: NO VERDICT. gate-selftest did not pass, so the gates could not prove they can fail. Every gate result this run is void - not suspect, void.

name: suite_green_on_head
description: PASS. Latest run per gate name is success on the current head SHA, and gate-selftest is among them.

name: suite_red_on_head
description: FAIL. Latest run per gate name includes conclusion=failure on this head. A real finding by a gate that had proved it could fail.

name: suite_absent
description: INDETERMINATE (skipped). Latest conclusion is skipped or null: the jobs were never started. Did not run is not red.

name: suite_unreadable
description: INDETERMINATE (could not check). The forge could not be read at all. preflight substitutes 99 for the count and exits 4 rather than guessing.

name: suite_history_mixed
description: UNNAMED. Every run ever attached to this SHA is still here, so old failures sit beside fresh successes. The verdict depends entirely on whether the reader takes latest-per-name.

name: suite_green_on_abandoned_sha
description: UNNAMED. The verdict is a pass, it is true, and it is about a build nobody is proposing. The head moved; the record did not go stale, it stopped matching.

name: suite_green_local
description: PASS, measured on a host that can reach the estate and carried to the forge as local/ commit statuses. gate-selftest runs first and its result gates the rest.

name: berth_requested
description: deploy:staging requested. The berth is an exclusive deadline-bearing lease on the path to production, and this is the claim on it.

name: berth_refused_behind
description: Guard 0 refused: the branch is BEHIND main. HYPOTHESIS, NOT CONTROL - zero lifetime refusals, because the forge has never returned BEHIND in this configuration.

name: berth_refused_queue
description: Guard 1 refused: another open PR holds the berth. blocked:queue set, deploy:staging withdrawn.

name: berth_held
description: This PR holds the berth. Estate-global fact seen from the PR: exactly one PR may be here.

name: preflight_indeterminate
description: INDETERMINATE, and it blocks. preflight exit 4: the calendar, the forge, the draft flag or the estate could not be read. I could not check is not it passed and is not it failed.

name: preflight_frozen
description: preflight exit 3. A freeze is declared on the estate holder. A property of the world, not of this change.

name: preflight_lock_held
description: preflight exit 2/5 family: another deployment holds the lock, or a person left hold:staging, or the estate has an emergency in flight.

name: window_booked
description: change:scheduled. An entitlement to the path to production - not permission to deploy and not a promise it will happen.

name: window_expired
description: The reservation lapsed unattempted. Its OWN closure code: not failed (nothing was attempted) and not cancelled (nobody decided against it). The change keeps everything else.

name: obs_none
description: INDETERMINATE (nothing measured). No observation record exists for any instrument on this environment. evidence.sh latest exits 1 so a caller fails closed rather than reading silence as consent.

name: obs_current
description: PASS. The latest record for every required instrument is a pass AND names this head. The only shape that authorizes.

name: obs_stale
description: The latest record names a different build. Issue #16: the label survived a push that the measurement did not. Refuse - do not re-stamp.

name: obs_failed
description: FAIL. The latest record for an instrument is a failure on this head. Distinct from no record and from a record about another build.

name: obs_label_without_record
description: A staging:* or production:* label stands with no observation record behind it. A claim nobody can date, because a label cannot name a build.

name: obs_untested_instrument
description: UNNAMED. A record was written by an instrument that was never itself tested that run - the suite is void, so the measurement has a verdict and no warrant.

name: obs_contradiction
description: Both staging:e2e and staging:e2e-failed stand. Written by whichever instrument ran last, and last is not authoritative. A recorded failure alongside its pass is a contradiction, not a pass.

name: obs_superseded
description: An earlier record for the same environment and instrument has been replaced by a later one. Last wins. Counting both is the defect.

name: obs_uat_withdrawn
description: The acceptance record stands and the person took their label back. Non-repeatable observations need both - the record for the build, the label for the consent.

name: review_approved_on_head
description: CONSENT, naming this build. An APPROVED review whose commit_id is the head. Not an observation - nobody measured anything.

name: review_proxy_on_head
description: A review:proxy record naming this head. A proxy, never a person, and the record says so.

name: review_absent
description: No approval and no proxy record on this head, or an approval of an earlier commit. The head moved past the consent.

name: review_unreadable
description: INDETERMINATE. The reviews endpoint did not answer, so the head is UNCONFIRMED and reviewDecision still stands, said out loud. Could not ask is not the head moved.

name: authorized_on_head
description: Guard 4 green: review, gates and every required observation taken ON THIS HEAD. A stack of named measurements, none able to stand in for another.

name: not_authorized
description: Guard 4 red, with the reason named: which instrument, which build, which of the three ways it failed.

name: prod_deploy_in_flight
description: deploy:production. An action in flight, not a request and not a result.

name: prod_healthy_on_head
description: PASS. N samples per route, all reporting the expected build, one response carrying both facts. Recorded as production:healthy naming the SHA that was sampled.

name: prod_unconverged
description: More than one build served across the samples. Not unhealthy: the estate is mixed, which one sample cannot distinguish from converged.

name: prod_unhealthy
description: FAIL. Samples came back and did not carry the expected build.

name: prod_unreachable_as_unhealthy
description: DEFECT STATE. HTTP 000 - the estate was never observed - is counted as a bad sample and reported UNHEALTHY. Class 1 inside guard 5 itself.

name: prod_healthy_label_without_record
description: production:healthy stands with no record behind it. The #16 shape at the merge boundary: a label that cannot say which build converged.

name: merge_not_yet
description: Guard 6 NOT YET. production:healthy is absent because nothing has been deployed. Red for most of a PR life, by design, and it says so rather than reading like a broken test.

name: merge_refused_stale_measurement
description: Guard 6 FAIL. production:healthy is present and the observation behind it names a different build. A different red from NOT YET, deliberately.

name: merge_refused_prod_other_build
description: Guard 6 refused because production serves something else. HYPOTHESIS, NOT CONTROL - 484 runs, never once triggered by a label.

name: merge_exempt_proven
description: deploys(c) is PROVABLY empty: the diff was read and touches nothing deployable. Exempt, and the message names which oracle proved it.

name: merge_exempt_unproven
description: DEFECT STATE. deploys(c) was indeterminate - groups.sh could not answer and the error was swallowed - and the guard treated the empty set as exempt. Absence of evidence granted as proof.

name: merge_allowed
description: Guard 6 green. Production serves this head, so trunk may follow it. The merge is settlement, not authorization.

name: deployed_unmerged_window_gone
description: UNNAMED. Production serves a build trunk does not contain, and the reservation that authorized it has lapsed. Three facts at once and no word for it.

name: complete
description: change:complete, then merged. About the change RECORD - nothing remains to observe. It does not expire, because it states what happened rather than what is true.

name: failed
description: ITIL closure code failed. Production never served it, or served it and never made it live. Nothing to undo.

name: backed_out
description: ITIL closure code backed-out. Production DID serve this and was returned to a prior state. The word asserts an estate action and must name what it returned to.

name: closed_unmerged
description: Withdrawn. The change record closes with no deployment and no debt.

name: estate_open
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. No freeze, no emergency in flight. Ordinary change may progress.

name: estate_frozen
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. freeze on the estate holder issue. Blocks everyone including its declarer and grants nothing to whatever carries it.

name: estate_emergency
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. emergency on the estate holder issue. Something is wrong out there and everything stops. Distinct from itil:emergency, which is a class.

name: berth_free
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. No open PR carries deploy:staging. Guard 1 reads the label set, not the workflow concurrency group.

name: berth_taken
description: ESTATE-GLOBAL. Exactly one open PR carries deploy:staging, possibly with no run in flight.
